title: False Alarms
summary: Simulate thousands of studies to measure the Type I error rate and power, then check power against power.t.test().
hints: One study with no real difference: `t.test(rnorm(20), rnorm(20), var.equal = TRUE)$p.value`. Wrap it in `replicate(2000, ...)`.
For a real effect of d = 0.5, give one group `mean = 0.5`: `rnorm(20, mean = 0.5)`.
`mean(p_null < 0.05)` is the share of false alarms; `mean(p_effect < 0.05)` is the simulated power, and β is 1 minus it.
